The favorable seed was side-concentrated: long was 5W/1L, +$1.928432, PF 9.6123; short was one winner for +$0.232488. All six winners exited through maximum hold and the only loss used the protective stop.

A linear notional-normalized scenario maps those seven outcomes over 2.99 days to +$108.8049 at $1,250, or +$63.7480 without the largest winner; this is an economic-relevance sensitivity, not a forecast or a fill replay.

risks_and_failure_modes: The seven-trade favorable HYPE-only slice may be regime luck or small-sample noise.
The favorable seed was overwhelmingly long-side evidence; one short winner cannot establish a short-side edge.
The one-year generic replay was negative and directly contradicts a durable unconditional edge claim.
The first $75 profile lost before cross-asset execution, so transfer was not the only source of deterioration.

The favorable first-seven slice spans three historical profile fingerprints and more than one observed holding duration; entry parity is proven, but their pooled profit cannot validate one exact exit implementation.

Both historical live extensions favored estimated fixed-eight-hour closes, but those closes were counterfactual and both trades were long. The repaired complete-contract replay remains split by partition; the second forward boundary agreed with EXIT under the production extension control but cannot prove durable exit superiority.

The entry mechanism is source-verified, but current routing, protection, persistence, and exit infrastructure intentionally differ from the historical runtime and still require an exact transitive prestart freeze.
The strategy may remain too sparse to create meaningful monthly PnL.
The two report-only forward paths are positive only because of one winner; a small additional loss would reverse their pooled result.
An 80 bps trigger is not a guaranteed realized-loss ceiling under gaps, latency, venue failure, or thin liquidity.
The 25 percent initial notional tier may still be too large if current HYPE execution friction is materially worse than the canary sample.
